parsed.rationale: All 16 members are empty `type-alias-object` records (fields_or_signature is [] for every entry), and they carry entirely unrelated domain names: `ConfettiView`, `DebugHUD`, `DialADJPage`, `HeightReader`, `InfoDetailView`, `WXYCLogo`, `WallpaperListView`, etc. The structural signal of `shared_field_count: 1` with `jaccard: null` and `differing_slots: null` indicates the pipeline matched solely on the fact that each declaration is a zero-field type alias — a coincidence of Swift syntax, not of semantics. The types are spread across at least eight distinct packages (`DebugPanel`, `WXUI`, `Wallpaper`, `PartyHorn`, `PlayerHeaderView`, `MusicShareKit`, `app:WatchXYC`, `app:iOS`) and encode completely unrelated UI concepts whose structural similarity is purely incidental. Consolidating or extracting them would destroy the meaningful domain separation that each alias provides within its own package.
